categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The list and detail request IDs align with data.list and the manual params.name path, and both direct lookup and selection feed that parameter.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The source and GET paths match the verified PokéAPI routes, with list limit and offset supplied as fixed request query options.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The template uses supported controls and collection expressions, a literal SubFetch ID, and permitted number formatting without reserved callback names.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: It renders a filtered loaded-name list beside detail results with artwork, types, abilities, and stat bars, but gates all lookup controls behind a nonempty successful list.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: The teal-accented two-column hierarchy is readable and avoids nested cards, though the name list is plain text and the overall treatment remains modest.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: The auto-fit SimpleGrid, 140-pixel minimum columns, and min-width safeguards allow the browse and detail areas to reflow without a fixed-height list.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: The list has loading, failure, and empty branches and detail has an initial prompt plus SubFetch-managed loading, failure, and success, but list failure also removes the direct lookup.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: Direct lookup, loaded-name selection, filtering, and list refresh are useful, but the displayed names are not themselves selectable and lookup is unavailable until the list succeeds.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: Two requests cover the required workflows and repeated filter expressions support counts and rendering, while the URL-derived list IDs add a small amount of incidental complexity.
categoryReasons.accessibility: Both inputs have visible labels, the detail launcher has an aria label, images have alt text, and statuses are conveyed with text as well as color.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: Both requests are read-only GET queries and the widget exposes no destructive or mutating action.

strengths: Verified list and detail API routes with matching parameter names.
Direct lookup and loaded-list selection share one manual detail query.
Responsive split layout with artwork, type badges, abilities, and base-stat bars.
Visible labels, image alt text, and a labeled detail trigger.
problems: The list-state conditional replaces the browse and detail areas during list loading, failure, or empty results, so direct lookup is unavailable in those states.
Loaded names are rendered as inert text; selection requires using a separate searchable Select.
The visual hierarchy is functional but relatively plain for the requested polished widget.
highestImpactFixes: Keep the direct lookup and detail area mounted while rendering list loading, failure, and empty states inside only the browse area.
Reduce the gap between the filtered visible names and the Select used to choose one, while retaining only supported controls.
